generation_guards: Depict exactly one umbrella and exactly one elephant.
Place the umbrella in front of the pink elephant, with the umbrella visibly closer to the viewer than the elephant.
Keep both the umbrella and the elephant clearly visible; avoid having the umbrella completely hide the elephant.
Do not add extra umbrellas or extra elephants.
initial_plan.generation_strategy: Use a simple two-object composition with clear depth ordering: one pink elephant in the background and one umbrella in the foreground directly in front of it. Emphasize count clarity and visibility so the single umbrella and single pink elephant are easy to identify.
